Episode 164. Land of Abomination (1)
A black ship seemed to be hovering, as if trampling on the sky.
Close to 10 miles in total length, 'Ram' completely overshadowed other ships in the HyuFester's sky by its size alone.
"Is that... a ship...?"
Octavia spoke in a hollow voice.
As she said, the shape of Ram was closer to a 'floating fortress', like a Tushinjeon main hall, rather than a flying ship. It looked as if a black island was simply floating, not a ship.
"When did Runekandel make such a thing...!"
Kadun, who was gritting his teeth and shouting.
The great forces, who had enthusiastically found HyuFester, were feeling a chilling sensation in front of the power that Runekandel had hidden again.
It was even despairing.
What did we know about Runekandel all along?
The leaders of each power had no choice but to ask themselves the same question.
'We knew nothing... we knew nothing...! How much terrifying power they were hiding!'
How could this happen, how could they have been so ignorant of the enemy's reality?
Regret was useless.
"......My judgement was wrong. We should not have come to HyuFester."
He quickly acknowledged that his judgement to prepare for an all-out attack was wrong.

"It's not your responsibility. Kelliak also thought that the decision was right and gave final approval. It's all of our mistake who didn't know their power till now. Damn it! It even seems difficult to turn the fleet."
It was already too deep into enemy lines to escape.
Even far behind each fleet, the sky was dark as pitch. The aura of chaos blocked the turn of the ship.
Beyond just interfering with the turn, it was confirmed that it was pulling the fleet towards Ram. Gipfel was being forced to make a decision.
To fight against it.
Ram's attack had not yet begun. They were overwhelmed by the aura and the exterior, but they didn't know until they tried.
The great forces had also brought their maximum power.

"If we try to retreat forcibly, we'll only be attacked unilaterally. Besides, there must be constraints in manipulating such a huge power. We need to find it and target it somehow. Kinselro will have that in mind too!"
Kinselro was saying something exactly in line with Kadun's words.
[This is unexpected even for me. That they already made that. Is this how much despair Rosa Runekandel and Joshua Runekandel were carrying? It's literally the manifestation of an abomination......]
Only Orgal had seen Ram directly in the past.
At that time, even Orgal at his peak concluded that he could not handle the firepower of Ram.
If there is a silver lining in the misfortune, in Orgal's view, Ram was not yet perfect.
"Jin Runecandle, everything depends on him."
"Captain, what do you mean?"
"Master?"

[Even if it's not perfect, as long as Ram exists, it's absolutely impossible for us or Jipil to penetrate the sky and enter the Sword Garden. Even retreat is a dangerous decision that only causes damage.]
The captain's dimensional door was also affected by chaos. Chaos put a limit on all kinds of movement, such as Mote's dimensional shift and the Red Owl's space jump.
If you forcibly open a dimensional door, Kinzelo will only suffer devastating damage without inflicting any damage on Runecandel in the meantime.
[The only person fighting inside, I can only hope that Jin Runecandel will damage the power of Ram. Attack, retreat. That means it only makes sense if it is possible.]
Ram's power.
The spirit that covers the entire Sword Garden centered on Rosa Runecandel. There had to be a problem with that. Jipil and Kinzelo had to reap a little to plan for the next.
[I will reset the war goal. All fleets engage with Ram and support Jin Runecandel. The top priority is to keep him alive.]
He leads the war to damage both Jipil and Runecandel.
Orgal quickly reversed his order. If Jin fails to hit Ram's power and dies, the outcome that the great forces will receive at that time is judged to be nothing but catastrophe.
So, the air battle between the two great forces and Runecandel began.
Of course, Ram was the one who started the preemptive strike. Chaos energy was gathering as the center of Ram's hull twisted like a whirlwind.
Main gun, an attack tool corresponding to it compared to a regular warship.
However, the blow that Ram poured out the next moment surpassed all kinds of naval guns known to the world, as large as it was. As if not even comparing.
Kwaah…!
The black band that divided the sky first hit Jipil's fleet.
Kadun, who had already transformed into his original form and came out of the ship, had to spread the flame with full power from the start.
The ships were tightly attached and deployed shields. The shield filled with all of Jipil's technology and magic seemed to be sparking in front of the black energy vomited by Ram.
It became a situation where it was torn mercilessly without a few seconds.
The shield centered on the flagship Cojec2 of the 2nd Fleet was the first to be pierced. Kadun and other strong men, and the other fleets around them, didn't even have a chance to help.
[Kuaah…!]
Kadun's roar was buried in the sound of the fleet being destroyed.
Rosa, standing at the forefront of Ram, chuckled at the sight.
[The sight of struggling like a bug is pitiful… Jipil's fire dragon.]
As if wrapped in ecstasy, Rosa's voice was trembling faintly. However, the prophet felt anxious about her appearance.
'The speed at which the mind is crumbling is too slow. Even though I am proving everything, why are you still wary of my power, Rosa Runecandel…!’
With a single shot, it silenced Cojec2 and drove the 2nd Fleet of Jipil to a state close to annihilation.
The current power of the Ram that the prophet had anticipated was about 50% higher than expected. Its full power has not yet been manifested due to Rosa's guard against it.
Rosa had been thoroughly discerning the prophet's inner thoughts.
[Despite demonstrating this much ability, it seems you're annoyed by the fact that I am wary of being completely assimilated by you?]
"That's not the case."
[The day Runecandle becomes fully dependent on you will never come. Your role is simply to provide power. While parasitizing my lineage...]
"Hmm, it's regrettable that you're rejecting a more effective path. You always tend to do that."
[Everything depends on my judgement. Don't forget that your essence is nothing more than a servant to my lineage, Ilina Runecandle. Is the youngest still not ready?]
"Stem and Lionel are present, it'll be resolved soon..."
[You surely must know that it's definitely insufficient with just that. You're hoping I step in personally.]
The prophet bowed his head.
Rosa was definitely different from Joshua in dimension. The prophet couldn't do anything as he intended against her.
[This is your last chance. After today, if you look down on me even once more, I will terminate our contract.]
"I apologize."
[Summon him.]
When Ram's first barrage ended, Kadun was panting heavily with his scales turned over.
For the first time since birth.
He was experiencing a sense of total loss of will. A feeling he had never experienced when he faced Murakan a thousand years ago was shaking his inner self.
Nevertheless, Kadun gathered the breath of flame with all his strength. If it were any other dragon, it would never have been able to do so.
[The blessing of Shinu will be with us...!]
As Kadun charged, Zieff's fleet was also advancing, matching speed using Ram's manpower.
Indeed, they had resilience. Where the Kojak2 disappeared, a newly summoned fleet of phantoms filled the space, and the protective barrier destroyed by Ram's attack was quickly being restored.
They were all assisted by the firepower that Kadun was releasing.
Hedo shot his sword energy riding the Wind Dragon Sallion with Octavia, and the phantom groups unfolded continuous magic afterwards.
It would take time for Ram's main cannon to be ready again. From what could be seen, the gathering speed of the spirit into Ram was not fast.
In the rear, Kinsello was rushing in. Unlike Zieff who had withstood Ram's attack, they hadn't received any damage yet.
Zephyrine at the forefront was larger than ever. She was drawing all of Orugal's power that she couldn't use due to restrictions.
However, as Orugal hadn't fully recovered yet, there was a clear limit to her replicating her heyday.
About an hour.
The translation of your Korean text to English is as follows:
Though not long-lasting, she had become a being nearly the strongest in the demon world and was able to engage in battle during that time.
Therefore, Zephyrin was full of confidence. Unlike the foolish Zipil guys who didn't bring Kelliak, she was sure she could land a solid hit on Runcandel.
That is, until Ram released what it was holding.
"Didn't I tell you, Zephyrin. You can't attack Ram before the real Runcandel creates a variable on the ground. Don't be greedy."
"Damn, master! What is that!?"
"Chaos, it's her creation....."
Aaaah-! Caw!
What came out of Ram's hull was, hundreds of dragons.
'Chaos Dragons' - Heluram's creations. And similarly, there were black ships numbering in the hundreds.
The Chaos Dragons and black ships were guarding Ram. They were continuously breathing fire and shooting cannons, deploying shields, and warding off attacks from both forces.
The entire sky was shining dizzily. The scenery of war seemed not like a fight between humans, but the floundering of mortals challenging grotesque gods.
Chaos dragons ripped apart Zephyrin and the fleet, letting out bizarre screams.
Amidst the exploding human and dragon blood, chaos flesh and bones,
Orgal watched the middle of the Sword Garden on the ground.
Jin's phoenix was fading.
Ha, Ha...!
Jin looked down at the fallen ones, panting heavily. Stan had stopped moving with only half his body remaining, and Lionel was kneeling on one knee, spewing blood foam.
'Lionel's last decisive battle was definitely dangerous... Even if his mind was corrupt, a lord is a lord.'
Jin's injury appeared between the shattered Muta rune and the spirit armor.
It was true that his energy was rapidly depleted, but he was not yet unable to continue fighting.
Before finishing off Lionel, Jin looked up at the sky. He saw Ram, and below it, the fighting Chaos Dragons and black ships, and the fleets of the large forces.
'Against those things... I wonder if the Council of Elders can hold out.'
Like those outside, Jin was also a bit anxious about the continually unexpected power of the clan. At a glance, the two forces were already being pushed back.
Lionel raised his head.

[The child of Runcandel, whom I experienced as the strongest... you were born in the wrong era. If there were a child like you in my time... there wouldn't have been the birth of a monster in the clan.]
Jin didn't answer and went over to cut Lionel's throat.
As he tried to find the prophet next, the fallen Lionel's neck was making this voice.
[And, they wouldn't have had such a disgraceful fight against the most shining descendant of the clan's heroes....]
Jin was feeling another old hero's energy appearing from the spirit tomb.
That was an energy Jin had once seen before.
